scope: 05 only. Full physical Nishikawa–Hukushima Hamiltonian; no 04 term deletions. No retraining, new physical states, trajectories, paid GPU or 06. Target-specific ordinary/exact eigenvectors are TRAIN-only analytic comparators, never replacements for the literal transferred scalar.
sampling: Digits=(vac,A,B); source 223, adjacent A↔B=214/232, vacancy removed=133/124, vacancy added=313/322. All 163840 L20 identities from 03, 8192 TRAIN + 8192 TEST per beta, all ten beta. Identical keyed 216 disjoint candidate-star order. First eligible star separately per sector per parent; one equal vote per contributing parent per sector, report missing/anchor counts. Never pool sectors or treat shared lineages as independent. Between-sector displays compare marginal ensembles descriptively, not a same-exterior intervention; no cross-sector significance tests.
physics: Reuse source banks where valid. Verify reconstructed source anchors/counts/observed interior and sufficient exterior data against original. For all neighboring sectors enumerate lexicographic states in source star-axis order, all changed cavity and occupied exterior energy terms. Verify every state of representative wrapping stars for each beta/side/sector against full L20 integer energy differences. Verify beta-zero uniform and null; no generated replicas.
transfer: Three actual 03 final stock kernels (6101/6102/6103) per beta. 10257 updates for beta indices 0..8; 10218 for 9. Same masked 3D species embedding, TF32-rounded operands as verified in 03, stock logits >=0 give label 2*b0+b1. Require exact equality of all 03 source labels, finite-logit replay agreement at 03 tolerance before target extrapolation; record near-zero/ambiguous signs. Use source TRAIN-fitted four coefficients literally, never target alignment or fitting. On target flag unidentified if any structurally occupied label lacks a source-supported coefficient (absent, TRAIN mass <=1e-14 or nonfinite); also respect source numerical covariance rank. β=0 constant source code gives no scalar. Category readout remains available. Source T, intervals and published ordinary modes checked at 1e-9 incl matching undefined cases.
metrics: Exact independent-replica T = between/total and both variance components, absolute/fraction, paired learned-minus-target-linear and minus-center-vacancy, on held TEST parents. Source ordinary modes reused; targets fit 03 centered whitening to TRAIN site-linear and full supported indicators (mass >=1e-10; covariance cutoff max(1e-14,1e-12*largest)); test frozen modes only. Repeat exact-mode sensitivity using common TRAIN states mass >=1e-3 and exterior ESS >=100, report unestimable masks, eigen-gap, marginal and support. Ratios only if target-mode lower 95% >1e-4; scalar variance <1e-12, absent coefficients or too little support are not evidence of failure. Record target state counts, effective support/entropy, label masses/entropy, whole-state conditional coincidence.
categorical_null: Per seed/sector permute the entire state→label assignment with 64 fixed uniform PCG64 permutations from SeedSequence([509005,nVac,nA,nB,seed]), regenerated identically across beta. Unweighted multiplicities preserved, not Gibbs masses; same partition on every exterior. Compute S=sum_h Var_B(P_B(h)), D=1-sum_h(mean_B P_B(h))², normalized S/D if D>0, already a different estimand from T of scalar f. Report both collision terms, mass/entropy of true and all 64 nulls, null spread and paired true minus their arithmetic mean (separate raw and normalized, undefined if degenerate). Null draw spread is NOT a parent uncertainty. Flag |Htrue−mean Hnull|>0.1 nat as marked mass/entropy mismatch; never call this entropy-matched.
decision: Cold beta 3.05, each of six sectors separately. Substantive transfer if all three literal scores identified/nondegenerate, >=100 eligible independent parents each side, each pointwise paired-parent 95% lower T >.05 and lower fraction of target TRAIN-mode TEST T >.5. If an upper bound rules out a required floor for a seed, threshold contradicted; otherwise unresolved if a gate fails; unidentified/unsupported distinct. No choosing seed, beta or depth. Separately evidence of gain over target site-linear if all lower paired differences >.01; for categorical specificity versus the mean of 64 unweighted random assignments require all lower paired normalized differences >.01, and report mass comparability limitations regardless. Delta-method t95 across TEST parents within sector and fixed fits, including covariance with target reference/null, pointwise not familywise. Descriptive all-temperature heatmaps; no claim of bulk order or length.
